findings.title: getSubGroupsStream overloads still NPE when group deleted concurrently
findings.body: The same race fixed in getSubGroupsCount remains here: after isUpdated() returns false, the method directly calls modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...). If the group was deleted after this adapter was obtained from the cache, getGroupModel() returns null, so modelSupplier.get() returns null and the call throws NPE. The null check added to getSubGroupsCount should be applied to these overloads as well (see also lines 262 and 268).

findings.title: Concurrency test asserts before reader thread is joined
findings.body: The reader thread is started at line 139 and is never joined or otherwise awaited. The main thread sets deletedAll = true and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty, so the test can pass before the reader observes the stop flag, before an in-flight request completes, or even when the thread has not run at all. The thread can also continue making admin requests after the test method returns and after realm cleanup begins, causing flaky failures. Join the thread (with a timeout) or use an executor/latch to ensure it has exited before asserting.
